scripts.android: bun run sync && cap run android
scripts.ios: bun run sync && cap run ios
scripts.android:build: . ./.env && bun run sync && cap build android --keystorepath $ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH --keystorepass $ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASS --keystorealias $ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS --keystorealiaspass $ANDROID_KEY_PASS --androidreleasetype APK --signing-type apksigner
scripts.ios:build: bun run sync && cap build ios
